n = 13
edges = set()
for i in range(n):
    for k in [1, 2, 3]:
        j = (i + k) % n
        u, v = min(i, j), max(i, j)
        edges.add((u, v))
edges = sorted(edges)
print("Number of edges:", len(edges))
print("Edges:", edges)
# Verify degrees
degrees = [0] * n
for u, v in edges:
    degrees[u] += 1
    degrees[v] += 1
print("Degrees:", degrees)
print("Min degree:", min(degrees))
